question: Which of the following BEST describes the impact of the plantation system on Caribbean social structure?
options: It created a racially divided society with Europeans at the top and enslaved Africans at the bottom
It created equal opportunities for all groups
It had no lasting effect on Caribbean society

question: Which of the following BEST explains why the Caribbean has such a diverse population today?
options: Because Africans, Indians, Europeans, Chinese and indigenous peoples all came to or were brought to the region at different times
Because only one group of people settled in the region
Because the Caribbean has always been isolated from the rest of the world

question: Which of the following is a way in which the government of SVG provides services to citizens?
options: Building schools, hospitals and roads and providing police protection

question: A factory worker who makes furniture from timber is part of which industry?
Which of the following BEST describes what remittances are?
options: Money sent home by Caribbean nationals living and working abroad

question: Which of the following is a way that deforestation affects the Caribbean water cycle?
options: Fewer trees means less transpiration which can reduce rainfall in an area
Deforestation has no effect on the water cycle

question: Which of the following is an example of how citizens can protect their environment?
options: Reducing use of plastics, recycling and not polluting rivers and beaches

question: Which of the following describes the difference between a need and a want?
options: A need is essential for survival such as food and water; a want is desired but not essential such as a toy
Wants are more important than needs
Needs and wants are the same thing

question: Which of the following is a festival that reflects the African heritage of Caribbean people?
options: Carnival with its music costumes and dancing rooted in emancipation celebrations
Christmas which is of European origin

question: Which of the following BEST describes what a community needs to thrive?
options: Good leadership, services, cooperation among residents and a safe environment

question: Which of the following BEST describes the impact of coral reef destruction on Caribbean tourism?
options: Damaged reefs reduce the appeal of the Caribbean for diving and snorkelling tourists reducing income
It has no effect on tourism

question: Which of the following is the BEST reason why education is important in the Caribbean?
options: It builds skills that help people improve their lives and contribute to national development
It is only useful for getting a job
It is only important for wealthy families

question: Which of the following describes the impact of a hurricane on a Caribbean farming community?
options: Crops are destroyed, livelihoods are lost and food security is threatened
Farming always improves after a hurricane
Hurricanes only affect coastal areas not farms

question: Which of the following is an example of how the Indian community has contributed to Caribbean agriculture?
options: Bringing rice and sugarcane farming techniques and establishing strong agricultural communities

question: Which of the following describes the role of the police in a Caribbean community?
options: Maintaining law and order, preventing crime and protecting citizens
